finding.required_regression: Add deterministic fault injection at the open-parent-to-link boundary for rename/replacement and symlink substitutions. Require no successful receipt for a parent no longer reachable as the same parent under the pinned root; cleanup may remove only the exact worker-created inode through the held FD after identity checks, and must preserve ambiguous artifacts rather than delete attacker/preexisting data. Document remaining platform/kernel race limits; do not claim portable atomic prevention absent an OS primitive that provides it.

Request/payload/result sizes are bounded, request and payload digests are checked, output is exclusive/no-follow and linked without replacement, file and containing directory fsyncs occur, final bytes and inode identity are re-read, and ambiguous post-publication failures preserve evidence rather than retrying blindly.
